search_notes: AstraZeneca press release of 22 Dec 2025: LATIFY did not meet OS vs docetaxel, no numbers. HR 0.90 (0.75-1.09, p=0.287; mOS 11.1 vs 10.0 mo) presented at ELCC 2026 (25-28 Mar, Besse); exact session day not found, earliest coverage opened is OncoDaily dated 27 Mar 2026.

BGB-A317-314 terminated with 3 patients enrolled; registry reason is a change in company-level development strategy, not safety (record updated 2026-03-02). No primary PFS analysis is possible; no release or abstract found by study number or drug name.

J&J topline press release of 14 Jan 2026 (PDF on investor site): MajesTEC-9 met PFS at the first prespecified interim analysis, HR 0.29 (0.23-0.38); OS HR 0.60 (0.43-0.83) also given. Part 2 CRS outcome is a separate safety primary and is not what is recorded here.

No stand-alone release: Amgen Q3 2025 results release of 4 Nov 2025 says only that FORTITUDE-102 "was stopped"; the reason (inadequate efficacy at an ad hoc analysis requested by the data monitoring committee) was given on the earnings call the same day and repeated in a Zai Lab notice of 5 Nov 2025 (read via a news relay; Fierce and Zai pages return 403). No efficacy numbers public; registry says only "terminated by sponsor".

Merck topline release of 17 Dec 2025: KEYNOTE-B15 / EV-304 met EFS, with OS and pCR also significant, no numbers. HR 0.53 (0.41-0.70) in the Merck release of 27 Feb 2026 for the ASCO GU presentation (LBA630); OS HR 0.65 (0.48-0.89).

No result found for BGB-290-302 by study number, BGB-290, pamiparib or Chinese name, in English or Chinese web searches or PubMed; registry (updated 2026-03-16) shows active, not recruiting with no results posted. BeOne news and quarterly coverage seen only in search summaries, none mentioning a readout.

No SAMETA readout found by acronym, savolitinib plus durvalumab, or sponsor: AstraZeneca H1/Q2 2026 results announcement (27 Jul 2026) and HUTCHMED 2026 interim results (30 Jul 2026), both opened, do not mention the trial. Registry active, not recruiting (updated 2026-05-22), actual primary completion 31 Dec 2025.

which_endpoint: PFS and OS (dual primary, both met at interim analysis)
search_notes: Sichuan Biokin (688506.SH) exchange notice naming BL-B01D1-307, read through a Chinese news relay stamped 23 Feb (2026); the SSE PDF itself not opened and may be dated 24 Feb. SystImmune/BMS English release followed on 25-26 Feb 2026. HR shown is PFS by BICR from ASCO 2026 (LBA1003); OS HR 0.60 (0.42-0.85). The company release with these numbers is dated 31 May-2 Jun; coverage opened is dated 2 Jun.

which_endpoint: PFS and OS (dual primary, neither met)
search_notes: No release: the BMS Q1 2026 results deck (30 Apr 2026) lists "KRAZATI in 2L CRC" as removed from phase 3 without stating a result (the Q4 2025 deck of 5 Feb 2026 still said "projected data readout 2026"). A BMS spokesperson then confirmed the miss to Precision Medicine Online (search summary only, 403). Explicit result and HRs came at ESMO GI 2026 (LBA1, 2 Jul): PFS HR 0.89 (0.71-1.13), OS HR 0.83 (0.67-1.03); coverage opened is dated 3 Jul.

No stand-alone release: one sentence in the Merck Q1 2026 results release of 30 Apr 2026 says KEYNOTE-866 did not show a statistically significant EFS improvement at a prespecified interim analysis. No hazard ratio public; searches by KEYNOTE-866, MK-3475-866 and the regimen found no abstract or paper yet. Registry status is completed.

which_endpoint: PFS (BICR); OS, the other primary endpoint, not significant at this interim analysis
search_notes: Merck/Eisai release of 28 Oct 2025: LITESPARK-011 (MK-6482-011) met PFS at a prespecified interim analysis, OS trend only. HR 0.70 (0.59-0.84) in the release of 28 Feb 2026 for ASCO GU; OS HR 0.85 (0.68-1.05). Disclosed three months before the registry primary completion date.

No disclosure found for the China extension itself (NCT05899049, 251 patients). The global LITESPARK-012 study, a different registry record, missed PFS and OS at an interim analysis (Merck/Eisai update of Apr 2026, repeated in the Merck Q1 2026 release of 30 Apr 2026); nothing found says how the China extension was analysed. Registry active, not recruiting (updated 2026-08-20).

Pfizer topline release of 19 Mar 2026 for TALAPRO-3 (C3441052), read as reproduced by UroToday because pfizer.com and Business Wire return 403: rPFS met, "exceeded the pre-specified target hazard ratio of 0.63", no number. HR 0.481 (0.357-0.647) presented at ASCO 2026 (LBA5007) with a Pfizer release dated 30 May 2026 (search summary only); the source opened is OncLive of 2 Jun, so the HR date is probably 3 days late.

AstraZeneca high-level results of 14 May 2026 from a planned interim analysis: durvalumab plus EV improved EFS and OS; the tremelimumab triplet improved EFS with OS not yet significant. No numbers; data promised for a forthcoming meeting and nothing with a hazard ratio found by 8 Oct 2026.

TIM terminated for slow recruitment (174 enrolled of about 520-550 planned); registry says follow-up was completed per protocol, and the EU CTIS record shows the trial ended 24 Apr 2026. No results posting, paper (PubMed) or Abnoba statement found in English or German searches; a descriptive analysis of the 174 patients could still appear.

ARO-013 presented as an ASH 2025 oral (abstract 767, 8 Dec 2025): 106 randomised of 276 planned, median EFS 3.4 vs 0.0 mo. Earliest sources opened are the Roswell Park release and a VJHemOnc interview of 8 Dec (EFS met, no HR); HR 0.64, p=0.013, no CI, is from a trade article of 10 Dec. The ASH abstract was probably online from early Nov 2025 and the talk itself probably showed the HR, but neither could be opened.

PharmaMar / Jazz release of 12 Jun 2026 (pharmamar.com is script-gated; read as reproduced by 1stOncology and in CancerNetwork coverage): LAGOON did not meet OS. HR shown is lurbinectedin monotherapy vs control, the primary comparison; the lurbinectedin plus irinotecan arm, described as exploratory, had HR 0.902 (0.729-1.115).

BMS / 2seventy bio topline release of 10 Aug 2022 (Business Wire blocked; read as posted by the International Myeloma Foundation): KarMMa-3 met PFS at a prespecified interim analysis, no numbers. HR 0.49, p<0.0001, no CI, in the BMS release of 10 Feb 2023 (NEJM publication and EBMT-EHA CAR T meeting); the NEJM paper gives the CI. The registry primary completion date of April 2026 is 44 months after the readout.

Roche release of 9 Aug 2021 (Genentech version dated 8 Aug US time): POLARIX met PFS, no numbers. HR 0.73 (0.57-0.95) in the Roche release of 14 Dec 2021 for the ASH late-breaking abstract and NEJM paper; the abstract may have been online a few weeks earlier. The registry primary completion date of April 2026 is nearly five years after the readout.

No result found for the Asian vorasidenib study (CL3-95032-016, 57 patients, China and Taiwan) by study number, S095032, AG-881, vorasidenib or Servier; Servier 2026 news seen in search results covers only INDIGO follow-up. Registry active, not recruiting (updated 2026-06-04). Servier newsroom not opened directly.

Pfizer topline release of 22 Jun 2026 (PDF on investor site): SigVie-002, formerly Be6A Lung-01 / SGNB6A-002, did not show a significant OS improvement for sigvotatug vedotin vs docetaxel. No numbers; data to be submitted to a future congress and no hazard ratio found by 8 Oct 2026.

CheckMate 9DX not read out as far as public sources show: the BMS Q2 2026 results deck (30 Jul 2026, opened) still lists it as "projected data readout 2026", and searches by acronym, CA209-9DX and adjuvant nivolumab HCC found no later release or abstract. Registry active, not recruiting (updated 2026-07-31).

AstraZeneca / Daiichi Sankyo high-level results of 17 Aug 2026: DESTINY-Lung04 (D967SC00001) met PFS, no numbers. HR 0.63 (0.50-0.79) in the AstraZeneca release of 14 Sep 2026 for the WCLC presidential session (PL03.08; US wire copy dated 13 Sep). OS HR 1.15 (0.88-1.52), not formally tested.
AstraZeneca high-level results of 17 Aug 2026 (RNS copy; HUTCHMED announced the same day): SAFFRON met PFS and the key secondary OS. No numbers; nothing with a hazard ratio found by 8 Oct 2026.

which_endpoint: PFS (both zanidatamab arms); OS met only for the tislelizumab arm
search_notes: Topline of 17 Nov 2025, read in the Zymeworks release (8-K exhibit 99.1, mirror copy) because the Jazz and Zymeworks investor sites return 403; Jazz issued its own release the same day. No numbers. HR shown is zanidatamab plus chemo vs trastuzumab plus chemo from the ASCO GI slides of 8 Jan 2026 (LBA285); the tislelizumab triplet had PFS HR 0.63 (0.51-0.78). Disclosed eight months before the registry primary completion date.

PACIFIC-8 stopped without a primary analysis: AstraZeneca H1/Q2 2026 results (27 Jul 2026, RNS copy opened) say it was discontinued "based on results of" the Arcus/Gilead trials STAR-121 and STAR-221, with no new safety signals; Arcus confirmed the discontinuation on 5 Aug 2026 (10-Q and call) without a reason. One automated summary calls it futility; no company source does.

RAINFOL-02 (GCT1184-02) not read out: Genmab release of 3 Oct 2026 and IGCS coverage of 5 Oct 2026 report only phase 1/2 RAINFOL-01 data and describe the phase 3 data as still to come in 2026. Searched acronym, Rina-S, rinatabart sesutecan and Genmab news; the Genmab investor site returns 403, so releases were read through news wires.

Arcus release of 12 Dec 2025 (8-K): STAR-221 discontinued for futility on the IDMC recommendation after a prespecified interim OS analysis, no numbers; Gilead and Taiho statements followed. HR 1.01 (p=0.526) presented at ESMO GI 2026 (abstract 493O), first read in OncoDaily of 3 Jul 2026 without a CI; OncLive of 7 Jul gives 95% CI 0.86-1.17. Registry primary completion date is eight months after the stop.
